subject: Novacorp SIG prep: presigned upload plan & evidence owner confirmations
messages:
From: Luke Fisher <luke.fisher@novacorp.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: security@novacorp.com
Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: SIG intake & upload workflow question

Hi Irene / team,

Thanks for the quick intake last week. We're kicking off the SIG/CAIQ run on our side and have a couple of logistical questions before we schedule the walkthrough:

- Preferred method for exchanging logs: our security ops prefers presigned S3 uploads (short-lived URLs) rather than SFTP. Will Redwood accept presigned uploads and are there any constraints we should know about?
- Telemetry/log sample window: we typically provide 21–30 days. For clarity: is 30 days preferred for CAIQ correlation, or is 21 days sufficient?
- Evidence ownership: who at Redwood should we upload owner-specific artifacts to? We can populate an evidence matrix if you share a template.

We can be available for a 30–45 minute walkthrough next week. Timezone: PST. Primary participants on our side will be me (Luke), Avery Shaw (controls lead), and the security@novacorp.com mailbox.

Attached a short preflight (Novacorp-SIG-preflight.pdf) showing the log types we plan to share.

Thanks,
Luke Fisher
Sr. Information Security Manager
Novacorp

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Luke Fisher <luke.fisher@novacorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, security@novacorp.com
Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG intake & upload workflow question

Hi Luke — thanks for the details and the preflight doc. Short answers up front, then proposed next steps:

- Presigned uploads: yes, we support presigned S3 uploads. We have a few constraints to avoid upload failures: fine-grained expirations (recommend 24–72 hours for one-time batches), object key prefixing by account id, and an MD5 checksum header for larger bundles. If you prefer a managed SFTP transfer, we can also open a temporary SFTP window.
- Sample window: 21 days is acceptable for initial SIG correlation; 30 days is preferred if you want more complete telemetry for regression checks.
- Evidence owners: please map artifact types to the matrix. I've attached our template (novacorp_evidence_matrix.xlsx) — populate the "owner" column and we'll route requests to the correct Redwood owner.

Proposed call slots (30–40 min):
- Tue Jul 21, 10:00–10:40 PT
- Tue Jul 21, 15:00–15:40 PT (if you need EMEA overlap)
- Wed Jul 22, 09:30–10:10 PT

Action items if we pick presigned URLs:
1) You populate the evidence matrix with owners and upload plan.
2) We share a presigned-upload checklist and a short script to validate checksum after upload (attached as presigned_upload_instructions.txt).
3) Decide sample window (21 vs 30 days) and whether logs will be redacted before upload.

Attaching: redwood_sig_prep.pdf (brief CAIQ mapping + contact list) and the evidence matrix template.

If any of the proposed times work, reply with the preferred slot and we will calendar the call.

Best,
Irene Choi
Security Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Luke Fisher <luke.fisher@novacorp.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, security@novacorp.com
Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 13:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG intake & upload workflow question

Luke — quick confirmation from ops side: we can accept presigned S3 uploads and will ask for a 7-day presigned URL expiry for multi-part batches (single files can be shorter). We also prefer object keys scoped like: novacorp/NC-2026-114/{artifact-type}/{filename}.

For the sample window: 21 days is fine as a minimum for the initial run. If you later want 30 days for more coverage, we can coordinate a secondary pull.

I've attached a tiny upload helper (presigned_upload_instructions.txt) that shows how our validator checks MD5 and size. We can also provide a short Python script to generate the presigned URL on your side if helpful.

Agenda suggestion for the call (30 min):
- 5m: participants & scope
- 10m: upload mechanics (presigned URL flow, keys, expiry)
- 10m: evidence matrix walkthrough (owners + missing artifacts)
- 5m: next steps & commit dates

If Tue Jul 21 10:00 PT works, we'll send calendar invite and add a short Zoom link.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Security Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Luke Fisher <luke.fisher@novacorp.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: security@novacorp.com, Avery Shaw <avery.shaw@novacorp.com>
Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG intake & upload workflow question

Thanks — Tue Jul 21 10:00 PT works for us. I'll send a calendar hold.

Avery Shaw (avery.shaw@novacorp.com) will be the primary evidence owner for controls and will populate the matrix with names for app owners / infra owners. Quick notes from our engineering lead:
- We'll use presigned S3 uploads with 48-hour expirations for all multi-file batches.
- We'll upload a 21-day sample for the initial pass; plan a follow-up 30-day set if the reviewers request more context.
- Regarding PII: we will redact user identifiers before upload. Please confirm if Redwood needs any additional masking or if redact-at-source is sufficient.

Also: please confirm whether Redwood requires a signed attestation of SOC 2 status ahead of the CAIQ walk; we can include our SOC 2 report in the evidence bundle if needed.

Luke
Sr. Information Security Manager
Novacorp
